title: Microsoft Makes Radical Cuts to Its AI Business: Merging Copilot Apps and Cutting Several Lesser-Known Features
excerpt: Microsoft has made significant adjustments to its artificial intelligence strategy, announcing the full integration of consumer and business versions of the Cop
content_html:
Microsoft has made significant adjustments to its artificial intelligence strategy, announcing the full integration of consumer and business versions of the Copilot app, while phasing out several AI features that did not meet expected outcomes. This move not only reflects the increasingly blurred boundaries between personal and professional scenarios in AI applications, but also signals that Microsoft's previously complicated product layout needs to change in order to better compete with rivals such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

According to related support documents, several consumer-oriented features will be officially discontinued on August 18, including group chat functionality, AI-generated podcasts, experimental Copilot Labs features, and deep research. However, paid professional users will have corresponding alternatives through the Researcher feature in the future. Additionally, Microsoft has decided to remove the previously controversial virtual animated character called Mico. During the transition period, files generated by the standalone Copilot app will be automatically migrated to OneDrive.

The core goal of this simplification is to create a simpler and more cohesive user experience. Microsoft has recently emphasized that all features must truly demonstrate their value in users' daily lives, and it is decisively eliminating ineffective modules. In the current context where major technology companies are integrating their AI applications, Microsoft is optimizing resources by streamlining its architecture to establish a stronger position in the fierce market competition.

content_html_zh:
微软对其人工智能战略进行了重大调整，宣布全面整合消费者版和商业版的Copilot应用，同时逐步淘汰了多项未达到预期效果的AI功能。 此举不仅反映出AI应用中个人场景和专业场景之间的界限日益模糊，也标志着微软此前复杂的产品布局需要改变，以便更好地与ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini等对手竞争。

根据相关支持文件，多项面向消费者的功能将于 8 月 18 日正式停止，包括群聊功能、AI 生成的播客、实验性 Copilot Labs 功能和深度研究。 不过，付费专业用户未来将通过研究员功能有相应的替代方案。 此外，微软还决定删除之前备受争议的虚拟动画角色“Mico”。 在过渡期间，独立 Copilot 应用程序生成的文件将自动迁移到 OneDrive。

这种简化的核心目标是创建更简单、更具凝聚力的用户体验。 微软最近强调，所有功能必须真正在用户日常生活中展现其价值，并且正在果断淘汰无效模块。 在当前各大科技公司纷纷整合AI应用的背景下，微软正在通过精简架构来优化资源，以在激烈的市场竞争中建立更强有力的地位。
